cards.hint: Think about earning on past earnings too.
options: interest on both the money you save and the interest you earn
fees charged only when money is withdrawn
money added only from monthly deposits
cards.quote: Compound interest: When you earn interest on both the money you save and the interest you earn.
cards.stem: What does compound interest mean for money in a savings account?

cards.hint: Think about timing and growth over time.
options: The sooner you start saving for post-secondary education
Waiting longer always earns a higher return
Delaying saving keeps spending power steady
cards.quote: The sooner you start saving for post-secondary education, the faster your money can grow from compound interest.
cards.stem: Why is it helpful to begin setting aside funds at a young age?

cards.hint: Think about adding to the starting amount.
cards.quote: Increasing the compounding frequency or your interest rate or adding to your principal can help your savings grow even faster.
cards.stem: Which action can help savings grow even faster over time?
